scheme_name: Mukhyamantri Samajik Sahayata Prakalpa - Old and Infirm
other_conditions: Applicant must be a resident of Tripura.
For old applicants, age must be 60 years or above.
For infirm applicants, must be affected by Cancer, AIDS, or Leprosy.
If the family has children aged 6 to 14 years, those children must be enrolled in a school recognized by the Government of Tripura.
Assistance will be stopped upon death of the beneficiary, remarriage of a widow, a family member obtaining a government job, or if the family income exceeds ₹1,00,000.
benefits_summary: Monthly pension of ₹2000 transferred directly to the applicant’s bank account.
